description: Projected next Bitcoin blocks from this node's live mempool, ordered by cluster-mempool chunk fee rate: for each of the next 4 blocks the tx count, vsize, total fees and min / median / max sat/vB, the fee rate the next block needs, and a fee-rate histogram of the whole mempool. Paid per call. Price: 5 sats or US$0.005 (USDC) per call.
